corrections.reason: The three-legged Fidel ጠ in ያስለግጠዋል (he makes him foam/grimace, translating ወይሌውኖ) had faint inner legs and was misread as ገ.
In the classical Ge'ez chapter heading (ወተአግሦተ በጻ = and bearing with one's neighbor/companion), the glyph ጻ was misread as ደ due to ink fill in the upper loop.
In Luke 9:49 (ሊቅነ = 'Master', translated as መምህር ሆይ, followed by ዘርኢነ corresponding to the relative clause translation የከለከልነው አለ), the spaced/faded ነ and 1st-order ዘ were misread as በ ዝርኢነ.
